title: Activities
raw_text:
9/29/26, 10:19 AM
The disconnections that have been documented are then observed, for example in the following transactions:

e Display Installation

e Change Installation
e Display Device

e Change Device
They are also observed during the following:

e Meter reading
e Billing
e Extrapolation

e Device replacement

You can disconnect disconnection objects in several disconnection documents simultaneously. The reconnection is not actually
executed until the last reconnection request is received.

Activities

The disconnection is usually entered using the Change Disconnection Document transaction. However, you can also define it as a
workflow step.

Confirmation of the optional service order generated

e takes place directly in Service Management
e Can be done directly in disconnection entry

e Can be controlled by making the corresponding settings in Customizing.

In Customizing under Utilities Industry . Customer Service — Process Execution = Disconnection/ Reconnection — Define
Processing Variants for Disconnection Documents, you can specify that the service orders or service notifications are to be closed.

In the individual confirmation status, you can define whether service orders are to be set to technically closed or not performed.
Service notifications are always closed if this has been defined in Customizing.

Disconnection Document

Definition

The disconnection document is the processing unit for the agent. A disconnection document is generated for each disconnection.
It is used to log the process and enables you to directly reach all the entities involved.
